decisions.reason: As a newly launched product that was prominent on the home page and fits closely with a German electronics/instrument maker’s core capabilities, it is likely still above or near aspiration with enough slack to remain on the market while demand is assessed.

Although it was still actively presented on its own page after launch, its software-oncology positioning appears more uncertain and potentially less central to the firm’s core hardware business, so it is kept for now but with a materially higher risk of withdrawal if results fall short of aspiration.
